title: Dispatch CTW 8: Families Hear the Final Recording
summary: The archive releases a cylinder but declines to name every singer.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Relatives of the Hollow Junction staff listened to the new cylinder at the Post Office. They recognized fragments of voices, though the recording is too faint for a formal identification. One woman said her grandfather had spent his life regretting the message left unsent when the station burned.

Dr. Saye has added both cylinders to the Institute archive. The chorus has not returned to the live wires. Mr. Bell has instructed operators to treat any future song as an unverified signal requiring human confirmation.
